# Introduction

Assessment of multicollinearity among demographic and clinical factors using the
variance inflation factor (VIF). VIF is calculated for each variable by regressing
it against all other variables and computing VIF = 1 / (1 - R²). VIF < 5 indicates
low multicollinearity; VIF 5-10 moderate; VIF > 10 high.

# Load packages

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(writexl)
```

# Define file paths

```{r}
#| label: file-paths

input_file  <- "Input/Demographic and clinical information.xlsx"
input_pet   <- "Input/PET.CT_long_SATVI.xlsx"
input_mtb   <- "Input/Mtb.lineage_SATVI_ID_Predict-TB_TS.xlsx"
output_main <- "Output/Figure_S13A"

dir.create(output_main, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# Load data

```{r}
#| label: load-data

demo_data <- read_excel(input_file, sheet = 1) %>%
  filter(Comments == "success")

str(demo_data)

pet_data <- read_excel(input_pet, sheet = 1) %>%
  filter(Comments == "success") %>%
  filter(Visit == 0) %>%                
  select(ID1, Visit, CAVTOT, TLG) %>%
  mutate(
    CAVTOT = log10(1 + CAVTOT),
    TLG    = log10(1 + TLG)
  )

head(pet_data)
dim(pet_data)

mtb_data <- read_excel(input_mtb, sheet = 1) %>%
  filter(Comments == "success") %>%
  select(ID1, main_lineage)

head(mtb_data)
dim(mtb_data)
```

# Merge data sets

```{r}
#| label: merge-data

all_data <- demo_data %>%
  left_join(pet_data, by = "ID1") %>%
  left_join(mtb_data, by = "ID1") %>%
  select(ID1, Age, Sex, BMI_0, Temp_0, Smoking, MGIT_0,
         main_lineage, Previous_TB, Arm, CAVTOT, TLG)

dim(all_data)
head(all_data)
```

# Curate data for VIF analysis

```{r}
#| label: curate-data

# Clean and encode all variables
test_data <- all_data %>%
  mutate(
    Age          = as.numeric(Age),
    BMI_0        = as.numeric(BMI_0),
    Temp_0       = as.numeric(Temp_0),
    MGIT_0       = as.numeric(MGIT_0),
    CAVTOT       = as.numeric(CAVTOT),
    TLG          = as.numeric(TLG),       
    Sex          = factor(Sex,          levels = c("Female",   "Male")),
    Smoking      = factor(
                     ifelse(Smoking == "active smoker", "active_smoker_Yes", "active_smoker_No"),
                     levels = c("active_smoker_No", "active_smoker_Yes")
                   ),
    main_lineage = factor(main_lineage,  levels = c("lineage2", "lineage4")),
    Arm          = factor(Arm,           levels = c("A", "B", "C")),
    Previous_TB  = factor(
                     ifelse(Previous_TB == "0 episode", "No", "Yes"),
                     levels = c("No", "Yes")
                   )
  )

str(test_data)

# Convert all variables to numeric for VIF regression
vif_data <- test_data %>%
  select(-ID1) %>%
  mutate(
    Sex          = as.numeric(Sex)          - 1,   # Female=0, Male=1
    Smoking      = as.numeric(Smoking)      - 1,   # No=0, Yes=1
    main_lineage = as.numeric(main_lineage) - 1,   # lineage2=0, lineage4=1
    Previous_TB  = as.numeric(Previous_TB)  - 1,   # No=0, Yes=1
    Arm          = as.numeric(Arm)                  # A=1, B=2, C=3
  ) %>%
  drop_na()

cat(sprintf("Participants available for VIF analysis: %d\n", nrow(vif_data)))
cat(sprintf("Variables tested: %d\n", ncol(vif_data)))
```

# Calculate VIF

```{r}
#| label: calculate-vif
#| message: true

all_vars <- names(vif_data)

vif_results <- data.frame(
  Variable = character(),
  VIF      = numeric()
)

for (var in all_vars) {

  other_vars  <- setdiff(all_vars, var)

  formula_str <- paste(var, "~", paste(other_vars, collapse = " + "))

  tryCatch({
    model     <- lm(formula_str, data = vif_data)
    r_squared <- summary(model)$r.squared
    vif_value <- 1 / (1 - r_squared)

    vif_results <- rbind(vif_results, data.frame(
      Variable = var,
      VIF      = round(vif_value, 3)
    ))
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Error calculating VIF for ", var, ": ", e$message)
  })
}

# Add interpretation tier
vif_results <- vif_results %>%
  mutate(
    Interpretation = case_when(
      VIF < 5  ~ "Low",
      VIF < 10 ~ "Moderate",
      TRUE     ~ "High"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(VIF))

print(vif_results)
```

# VIF plot

```{r}
#| label: vif-plot
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 6

# Cleaner variable labels for the plot
var_labels <- c(
  "Age"          = "Age",
  "Sex"          = "Sex",
  "BMI_0"        = "BMI",
  "Temp_0"       = "Temperature",
  "Smoking"      = "Smoking",
  "MGIT_0"       = "MGIT Mtb burden",
  "main_lineage" = "Mtb lineage",
  "Previous_TB"  = "Previous TB",
  "Arm"          = "Trial Arm",
  "CAVTOT"       = "Total cavity volume",
  "TLG"          = "Total lesion glycolysis"
)

# Desired display order (top to bottom on flipped plot)
var_order <- c(
  "Age", "Sex", "BMI_0", "Temp_0", "Smoking",
  "MGIT_0", "main_lineage", "Previous_TB", "Arm",
  "CAVTOT", "TLG"
)

vif_results <- vif_results %>%
  mutate(
    Variable       = factor(Variable, levels = rev(var_order)),
    Variable_label = var_labels[as.character(Variable)]
  )

vif_plot <- ggplot(vif_results, aes(x = Variable, y = VIF, fill = VIF > 5)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 5,  linetype = "dashed", color = "orange", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 10, linetype = "dashed", color = "red",    linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", VIF)), hjust = -0.2, size = 3.5) +
  coord_flip(clip = "off") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = setNames(var_labels, names(var_labels))) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("FALSE" = "skyblue", "TRUE" = "coral"),
    labels = c("FALSE" = "Acceptable (VIF < 5)", "TRUE" = "Problematic (VIF >= 5)"),
    name   = "Multicollinearity"
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = "Variance Inflation Factors (VIF)",
    subtitle = "Dashed lines: orange = VIF 5 threshold, red = VIF 10 threshold",
    x        = NULL,
    y        = "VIF"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.border     = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    axis.text        = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.title       = element_text(color = "black")
  )

print(vif_plot)
```

# Save outputs

```{r}
#| label: save-outputs

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(output_main, "VIF_plot.pdf"),
  plot     = vif_plot,
  width    = 8,
  height   = 6
)

write_xlsx(
  vif_results,
  path = file.path(output_main, "VIF_multicollinearity among demographic and clinical factors.xlsx")
)

cat("Outputs saved to:", output_main, "\n")
```
